name: layers
purpose: A flat picture made of layers. Each layer has a place, a size, a turn, a fade and a depth, and a layer far away moves less than a layer that is near (parallax). A layer can have a handle that the learner drags.
binds: none: each layer binds its own numbers
keys: none on the picture; a handle takes A/D (left, right), W/S (up, down) and the arrows, and ⇧ moves ten steps

pan.doc: how far the camera moves: a number, or the key of a number; a layer with depth d shifts by -pan * d

label.doc: what the picture shows, for screen readers

note.doc: one short line under the picture

blocks.doc: layer blocks only, from the back to the front
